editor.places a rectangular block of material o: 在地面上放置一块矩形土石料

editor.adds a grayscale heightmap to the bedroc: 将灰度高度图叠加到基岩上；黑与白分别对应低值与高值设定
editor.deposits material from an image mask, wi: 根据图像遮罩堆积土料，按像素值设定材质与厚度

editor.creates scattered domes or narrow towers: 在矩形区域内生成零散的土丘或窄柱状地形
editor.scatters trees in a circle, limited by s: 在圆形区域内随机分布树木，受坡度和遮罩限制
editor.thins listed trees inside an outline, le: 在轮廓线内疏伐所列树木，保留树桩与荒地植被
editor.carves a hollow below the clicked ground: 在点击的地面下方挖出一处凹坑
editor.adds material under the brush; uses the: 在笔刷下方堆积土料；除非另选填充材质，否则使用当前地表材质
editor.raises the ground, including its layers,: 整体抬升地面（包括土层、草地和水体），不额外增加土料

shop.toml.old: spec = "one seat, one ski each side"
tagline = "The site's all-rounder: scoops, carries, ploughs and loads a truck in four passes."
shop.toml.new: tagline = "工地多面手：能铲、能运、能清雪，四斗装满一台卡车。"

shop.toml.old: tagline = "Twice the bucket, a pin hitch for trailers, and a cab you could live in."
shop.toml.new: tagline = "双倍斗容，带拖车牵引销，驾驶室宽敞得像家一样。"

shop.toml.new: tagline = "午饭前挖条沟，下午茶前挖个塘。标配快换接头。"

shop.toml.old: tagline = "Six wheels driven, a body that tips in eight seconds and a ride over anything."
shop.toml.new: tagline = "六轮驱动，八秒举升卸料，任何烂路如履平地。"

shop.toml.old: tagline = "Swap a tipper for a flatrack without leaving the seat."
shop.toml.new: tagline = "不下驾驶室就能把自卸斗换成平板架。"

shop.toml.old: tagline = "The boss's ride, the plough's mount, the coffee run."
shop.toml.new: tagline = "老板座驾，能挂雪铲，还能顺路买咖啡。"

shop.toml.old: tagline = "Two bodies, four tracks, and it floats when the creek is higher than you thought."
shop.toml.new: tagline = "双节车身、四条履带，溪水比想象中深也能直接浮过去。"

shop.toml.old: tagline = "For the morning round of the village and nothing heavier."
shop.toml.new: tagline = "清晨巡视村子刚好，别指望它干重活。"

shop.toml.old: tagline = "Kick it, ride it, drop it in the ditch. It doesn't mind."
shop.toml.new: tagline = "一脚踹响，骑上就走，掉进沟里也皮实得很。"
